name: Helicone
tagline: Helicone is an open-source LLM observability platform that acts as a proxy to log, analyze, and optimize API calls to OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. It provides usage analytics, cost tracking, prompt versioning, and caching to help teams improve LLM application performance.
